description: Opens a tileset in SpriteForge's tileset editor as an interactive card where the app shows them, and returns an edit link that opens the same editor in a browser. For a Wang autotile set (16 tiles; tile i is drawn where the map cells at its corners are painted, NW=1 NE=2 SW=4 SE=8, so tile 15 is the solid base; sets SpriteForge derives add 4 variants of tile 15 as tiles 16-19, mixed into painted floors) the user paints a small map to see the tiles chain, draws on the map or on single tiles, and edits the base texture, which re-derives the edge tiles (tiles drawn by hand stay); a platformer set (49 tiles) is edited tile by tile. With session_id it opens a tileset that's already in an edit session, and kind (wang = flat floor terrain, wall, iso) switches that Wang set's preview, keeping its tiles and the user's edits. Otherwise it makes a new set from kind (wang, wall, iso or platformer; default wang) plus palette + tiles (16 or 20 grids for Wang, 49 for platformer, in mask order), palette + base (a seamless square texture; the Wang tiles are derived from it as SpriteForge does), png_base64 (a tileset sheet or a texture), or size alone for a blank set. With png_base64 and no layout, a 16x1 or 20x1 image is a strip, a 4x5 one a sheet, and a square one is a 4x4 sheet when its tiles look like a Wang set in mask order (tile 0 empty, or nearly every tile's corners matching tile 15 where its mask has that corner and tile 0 where it doesn't), else a texture. The result says which view it opened and how it read the PNG. The user's edits save to the edit session.

base.description: A square seamless texture to derive a Wang set from (its 16 tiles and 4 variants of tile 15).

kind.description: wang (flat floor terrain), wall (Wang walls), iso (isometric Wang) or platformer. For a new set, default wang. With session_id, wang, wall or iso switches that Wang set's preview, keeping its tiles; a Wang set can't become a platformer set or the other way round.

layout.description: How to read png_base64: sheet (4x4 or 4x5 Wang sheet, or a platformer set's 7x7), strip (16x1 or 20x1) or texture (a square base texture the Wang tiles are derived from). Default: guessed from the image (see the tool description).

palette.description: Hex colours for tiles or base.

png_base64.description: A tileset PNG (a Wang set's 4x4 or 4x5 sheet or 16x1 or 20x1 strip, a platformer set's 7x7 sheet) or a square texture, base64.

session_id.description: An existing tileset edit session, or an edit link containing ?s=<id>. Give kind with it to change a Wang set's preview; the other fields are for a new set.

size.description: Tile size for a blank set (default 32).

tiles.description: The set's tiles in mask order (16 for Wang kinds, or 20 with tile 15's 4 variants after them; 49 for platformer), palette indexes, -1 transparent.

name: open_tileset_editor
title: Open the SpriteForge tileset editor
